# Audible

> > Audible is Amazon's audiobook and podcast platform offering a vast library of audiobooks, Audible Originals, and podcasts with subscription-based access.

Audible provides digital audio entertainment across multiple genres including fiction, romance, erotica, comedy, and science fiction, featuring popular titles like Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir and Harry Potter series by J.K. Rowling. The company operates production studios globally, including facilities in Newark and Berlin, and maintains active social impact programs supporting education and career development.

## Key Topics

- Audiobooks
- Audible Originals
- Podcasts
- Subscription service (Audible Standard)
- 30-day free trial
- Contemporary romance
- Erotica and adult fiction
- Dark romance
- Science fiction (Project Hail Mary, Andy Weir)
- Fantasy (Harry Potter, J.K. Rowling)
- Newark headquarters and studio
- Berlin production studio
- Women in tech initiatives
- Educational programs
- Career development programs

- [About Audible](https://www.audible.com/about): Company overview highlighting mission, values, and social impact programs

## Romance & Contemporary Fiction

- [A Merry Invitation: The Corporation](https://www.audible.com/ac/A-Merry-Invitation-The-Corporation-Audiobook/B0CPH7HGWV): Christmas romance novella in The Corporation series by A.C. Arthur
- [A Shot at Forgiveness](https://www.audible.com/ac/A-Shot-at-Forgiveness-Audiobook/B01HZKH0WI): LGBTQ second-chance romance by Cardeno C., narrated by Robert M. Clark
- [Absolute Silence](https://www.audible.com/ac/Absolute-Silence-Audiobook/B0B11NMJN1): Dark mafia romance, book 5 in The Five Families series by Ramsower
- [Addicted to the Ruin](https://www.audible.com/ac/Addicted-to-the-Ruin-Audiobook/B0D79MCRP7): Reverse harem romance, book 2 of Dead Soldiers vs Tailors duet by Lee
- [Alex](https://www.audible.com/ac/Alex-Audiobook/B00TSR60Q4): Hockey romance from Cold Fury series by Sawyer Bennett
- [A Girl for the General, Book 2](https://www.audible.com/ac/2-A-Girl-for-the-General-Book-2-Audiobook/B08L4656HC): Russian romantic suspense audiobook by Marina Kistyaeva, narrated by Kuznetsov

## Adult Fiction & Erotica

- [15 Stories of Erotica](https://www.audible.com/ac/15-Stories-of-Erotica-Stories-of-Threesomes-Anal-Sex-Lesbian-Sex-MILF-Sex-Gangbangs-and-More-Audiobook/B013RVXO3I): Adult erotica audiobook collection by Moore, Draper, and Winters
- [20 Raunchy Lesbian Sex Stories](https://www.audible.com/ac/20-Raunchy-Lesbian-Sex-Stories-Audiobook/B07XJ7FN6R): Adult lesbian fiction audiobook collection by Sanders and co-authors
- [50 Dirty Sex Stories for Adults](https://www.audible.com/ac/50-Dirty-Sex-Stories-for-Adults-Audiobook/B08TRRZR4W): Adult erotica collection narrated by Jennifer M. Bisgard
- [50 Misconceptions of Sex](https://www.audible.com/ac/50-Misconceptions-of-Sex-Audiobook/B08RRPMXZ5): Tantric sexual education audiobook by Alexa Vartman from The New Tantra

## Comedy & Entertainment

- [Anthony Jeselnik: Shakespeare](https://www.audible.com/ac/Anthony-Jeselnik-Shakespeare-Audiobook/B09MR8Q2PV): Dark comedy stand-up special by Anthony Jeselnik from Comedy Central

## Company News & Culture

- [Audible Unveils New Studio in Berlin](https://www.audible.com/about/newsroom/audible-unveils-new-studio-in-the-heart-of-berlin): Berlin studio opening announcement for German Audible Originals production
- [Audible Captions: A Demonstration](https://www.audible.com/about/newsroom/audible-captions-a-demonstration): Audible Captions feature demo for enhanced student literacy education
- [Careers Resumed After Caregiving](https://www.audible.com/about/newsroom/they-paused-careers-for-caregiving-now-their-journeys-resume-at-audible): Next Chapter Returnship Program helps caregivers restart tech careers
- [Software Engineers Share Their Stories](https://www.audible.com/about/newsroom/whats-it-like-to-work-with-us-our-software-engineers-share-their-stories): Software engineers share workplace culture stories from Newark and Cambridge

## Optional

- [Audible Tax Portal](https://tax.audible.com/): Tax portal for partners to manage IRS compliance and payment information
- [Future Leaders Program](https://www.audible.com/about/impact/future-leaders): Paid internship program for Newark students overcoming educational barriers
